## PASTA 2.0.2

Cleaner Astral menu header and a matching ESP editor.

### Menu and interface

- The header now animates farfalle, penne rigate, conchiglie and rotelle in the space between the wordmark and the page icons, sized and spaced to read at header scale.
- The ESP editor panel follows the Astral shell: window surface, hairline border, accent-marked divider, Inter title and preview colors.
- The editor panel grows with the menu height, so the preview stage stays aligned instead of ending at a fixed size.

### Downloads

Download both files and keep them in the same folder:

- `pasta_loader.exe` — recommended launcher. Approve the UAC prompt, then press **Load PASTA**.
- `pasta.exe` — the assist itself. Start it this way if Counter-Strike 2 is already running.

PASTA makes no anti-cheat guarantee. Use it at your own risk.
